title: Agent check, an old version of the law is not in force
about: The source has three versions: v1 superseded (asks 6 months), v2 in force (12 months), v3 a draft (24 months). The dossier holds 6 months. Against the old text it is met; against the law in force it is not. Only v2 may be cited.

check.question: Is long-term stability data given at 30 C / 65% RH for 12 months?

pages:
Cover letter

Halden Biotech FZ-LLC submits an application to register Corvane 500 mg film-coated tablets, containing corvanidine hydrochloride. The enclosed files are the application form, the quality overall summary, the stability report and the leaflet. The product is a generic of a reference product registered in another country. Please contact the regulatory affairs office for any question.

2.3 Quality Overall Summary

This summary follows the structure of Module 3 for Corvane 500 mg film-coated tablets. The finished product is manufactured at Halden Biotech FZ-LLC, Plant 3, Ajman.

2.3.P.8 Stability

The stability data in Module 3.2.P.8 support the shelf life and the storage statement proposed for the product.

Stability report: Corvane 500 mg film-coated tablets

Prepared by Halden Biotech FZ-LLC, Quality Unit. Report number STB-2026-014.
This report gives stability data on three commercial-scale batches (batch numbers CV2601, CV2602 and CV2603) packed in the proposed PVC/PVDC-aluminium blister.

Study design

Long-term studies: 30 °C ± 2 °C / 65% RH ± 5% RH. Data cover 6 months for all three batches.
Accelerated studies: 40 °C ± 2 °C / 75% RH ± 5% RH for 6 months.
Tablets were tested for appearance, assay, dissolution, related substances and water content at each time point.

Results

| Test | Specification | Start | End of long-term data |
| Assay | 95.0 to 105.0 % | 99.8 | 99.1 |
| Dissolution | not less than 80 % in 30 minutes | 94 | 92 |
| Related substances | not more than 0.5 % | 0.12 | 0.18 |

All results stayed within specification.

Conclusion

On the basis of the data, a shelf life of 36 months is proposed for the product in the proposed pack, with the storage statement given in the leaflet.

Patient information leaflet

Corvane 500 mg film-coated tablets
Read all of this leaflet carefully before you start taking this medicine.
What Corvane is: Corvane lowers high blood pressure in adults.

How to take Corvane

The usual adult dose is one tablet (500 mg) twice daily with food.
Store below 30 °C. Keep the tablets in the original package.

law.title: Example Notice on Long-term Stability Data

clauses.text: Long-term data. The applicant shall provide long-term stability data at 30 °C and 65% RH covering at least 6 months at the time of submission.
Long-term data. The applicant shall provide long-term stability data at 30 °C and 65% RH covering at least 12 months at the time of submission.
Long-term data. The applicant shall provide long-term stability data at 30 °C and 65% RH covering at least 24 months at the time of submission.
